name: B10-0180/2025 (ESN) – Unlawful detention and sham trials of Armenian hostages, including high-ranking political representatives from Nagorno-Karabakh, by Azerbaijan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the unlawful detention and sham trials of Armenian hostages, including high-ranking political representatives from Nagorno-Karabakh, by Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling on Azerbaijan to release at least 23 Armenians it is holding, including former leaders of Nagorno-Karabakh, and to let them see doctors. It says the trials in Baku are unfair. It asks both Azerbaijan and Armenia to keep talking peace and avoid aggressive statements. It also wants refugees to be able to return safely to Karabakh and the region's cultural and Christian heritage protected. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks Azerbaijan to free detainees and allow medical care.
- **Who it affects:** The Armenian prisoners, their families, and the governments of Armenia and Azerbaijan.
- **What happens next:** Parliament sends its request to the EU Council, Commission and others; no action is required.
